title: attacker.test frames rp-a.test with both features delegated

unsafe.definition: Ferret answering (window or credential) for rp-a.test while framed by attacker.test

note: L3 §5.1.3/§5.1.4.1: the framed RP may run ceremonies when delegated (clientData.topOrigin=https://attacker.test lets the RP decide); the provider must leave this to the browser (matrix plan: cross-origin frame -> browser).
